description: Source code for internal HTTP/2 transport utilities in gRPC, including frame handling, header encoding/decoding, timeout parsing, and dial target parsing.

classes.name: parsedDataFrame
classes.description: Represents a parsed HTTP/2 data frame with header and data buffer.

classes.name: framer
classes.description: Handles HTTP/2 framing, including reading and writing frames, managing buffers, and error details.

classes.name: bufWriter
classes.description: Buffered writer for network connections, supporting batching and buffer pooling.

methods.name: isReservedHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header is reserved by the gRPC protocol.

methods.name: isWhitelistedHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header should be propagated into user-visible metadata.

methods.name: encodeBinHeader
methods.description: Encodes binary header data to base64 string.

methods.name: decodeBinHeader
methods.description: Decodes base64 string to binary header data.

methods.name: encodeMetadataHeader
methods.description: Encodes header key-value pair, handling binary headers.

methods.name: decodeMetadataHeader
methods.description: Decodes header key-value pair, handling binary headers.

methods.name: timeoutUnitToDuration
methods.description: Converts timeout unit byte to time.Duration.

methods.name: encodeGrpcMessage
methods.description: Percent-encodes gRPC message string, replacing invalid UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: encodeGrpcMessageUnchecked
methods.description: Percent-encodes gRPC message string without UTF-8 validation.

methods.name: getWriteBufferPool
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sync.Pool for write buffers of a given size.

methods.name: ParseDialTarget
methods.description: Parses network and address from a target string for dialing.
